faqs.a:
Any place of business where an amusement device is maintained which exhibits or displays
               a picture or view by film, video, or a live exhibition meeting the definition of adult
               entertainment under
section 22-33
is governed by the provisions of
Chapter 4
regulating licenses for adult businesses.
(Code 1981, § 4-37; Ord. No. 3217, § 3, 9-18-1995; Ord. No. 3810, § 5, 6-16-2003)
